tracks.name: Meta-World v2原表 · MT10 · 状态型多任务RL
tracks.version: arXiv v2 2021 benchmark report; no asserted modern package version
tracks.split: training skills only; 500 sampled task configurations; task ID/goal available
tracks.protocol: Table 1最大成功率跨任务与10种子汇总；39维状态和任务编码，4维末端/夹爪动作，非像素VLA。每种环境50个预采样配置；MT评测已见技能，不是5类新技能泛化；不同算法预算按原附录保留，paper-table不排名。
tracks.trainingRegime: Online state-based RL, no demonstration budget; Appendix D separate per-method budgets: PPO/TRPO epochs10000, SAC epochs500, TE epochs4000; rollout horizon500. These are algorithm-defined epochs, not equal interaction budgets.

tracks.name: Meta-World v2原表 · ML10 · 元训练
tracks.version: arXiv v2 2021 benchmark report; no asserted modern package version
tracks.split: 10 meta-training skill families / 5 held-out meta-test families; meta-train
tracks.protocol: 39维状态型RL；任务ID不可见，依赖新交互进行梯度、递归状态或任务潜变量适应。Table 1跨任务/10种子最大成功率汇总；训练集和留出技能分开，不自造train+test总平均，不称零样本VLA。
tracks.trainingRegime: Meta-RL, no demonstrations; Appendix D: MAML 10 rollouts/task, RL² 10 rollouts/task, horizon500; PEARL probabilistic context with own sampling/update schedule. Not a common adaptation or compute budget.
